claims.assertion: Gosia says humanoid extraterrestrials are common and many could pass unnoticed among humans, while differing species range from very similar to physically unfamiliar.
claims.speaker: Gosia

claims.assertion: Gosia presents “Lyrans” as a shared humanoid root spanning Earth and extraterrestrial populations, which she says did not evolve on one planet alone.
claims.speaker: Gosia, citing Mari Swa

claims.assertion: Gosia says spacefaring cultures exchange ideas through travel and reincarnation, and that shared cultural concepts also arise through a collective unconscious.
claims.speaker: Gosia, relaying Taygetan views
